description: Defines the JsonArray interface for representing immutable JSON array structures, including factory methods, builders, and array manipulation methods.

classes.name: JsonArray
classes.description: Interface for immutable JSON array with methods for creation, modification, and querying JSON array data.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a JsonArray from a JSON string or a collection of values.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for constructing JsonArray instances.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder pre-filled with data from this JsonArray for modifications.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Returns a new JsonArray with the specified value appended.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value at a specified index.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a value exists in the array.

methods.name: indexOf
methods.description: Finds the index of a value in the array.
